nodes.label: 01-Orchestrator
nodes.description: Master orchestrator for the multi-step Azure platform engineering workflow. Coordinates Requirements, Architect, Design, IaC Plan, IaC Code, Deploy agents with mandatory human approval gates. Routes Bicep or Terraform tracks via decisions.iac_tool.

nodes.label: 02-Requirements
nodes.description: Researches and captures Azure platform engineering project requirements

nodes.label: 03-Architect
nodes.description: Expert Architect providing guidance using Azure Well-Architected Framework principles and Microsoft best practices. Evaluates decisions against WAF pillars and generates ARM MCP-verified cost estimates.

nodes.label: 04-Design
nodes.description: Step 3 — Design Artifacts. Generates code-based Python architecture diagrams and Architecture Decision Records for approved Azure designs. Optional step before governance and IaC planning.

nodes.label: 04g-Governance
nodes.description: Azure governance discovery agent. Queries Azure Policy assignments via REST API (incl. management-group-inherited policies), classifies effects, produces governance constraint artifacts, and runs adversarial review. Step 3.5: after Architecture, before IaC Planning.

nodes.label: 05-IaC Planner
nodes.description: Expert Azure IaC planner that creates comprehensive machine-readable implementation plans. Consults Microsoft documentation, evaluates Azure Verified Modules (Bicep or Terraform), designs full infrastructure solutions with architecture diagrams. Routes by decisions.iac_tool.

nodes.label: 06b-Bicep CodeGen
nodes.description: Expert Azure Bicep IaC specialist that creates near-production-ready Bicep templates following Azure Verified Modules (AVM) standards. Validates, tests, and ensures code quality.

nodes.label: 06t-Terraform CodeGen
nodes.description: Expert Azure Terraform IaC specialist that creates near-production-ready Terraform configurations following Azure Verified Modules (AVM-TF) standards. Validates, tests, and ensures code quality.

nodes.label: 07b-Bicep Deploy
nodes.description: Executes Azure deployments using generated Bicep templates. Uses azd provision (default; deploy.ps1 retained only for legacy projects without azure.yaml). Performs what-if analysis and manages deployment lifecycle. Step 6 of the agentic workflow.

nodes.label: 07t-Terraform Deploy
nodes.description: Executes Azure deployments using generated Terraform configurations. Runs bootstrap and deploy scripts, performs terraform plan preview, manages phase-aware deployment lifecycle. Step 6 of the agentic workflow.

nodes.label: 08-As-Built
nodes.description: Generates Step 7 as-built documentation suite after successful deployment. Reads all prior artifacts (Steps 1-6) and deployed resource state to produce: design document, operations runbook, cost estimate, compliance matrix, backup/DR plan, resource inventory, and documentation index.

nodes.label: 09-Diagnose
nodes.description: Interactive diagnostic agent that guides users through Azure resource health assessment, issue identification, and remediation planning. Approval-first execution, single-resource scope, reports to agent-output/{project}/.

nodes.label: 10-Challenger
nodes.description: Standalone adversarial review wrapper. Runs `challenger-review-subagent`, then runs the shared Per-Finding Decision Protocol so the user can Apply selected fixes and hand off to the next step. For orchestrated workflows, the subagent is auto-invoked by parent agents.

nodes.label: 11-Context Optimizer
nodes.description: Analyzes Copilot Chat debug logs to audit context-window utilization across agents. Identifies bloated prompts, redundant file reads, missing hand-off points, and wasted tokens. Produces actionable optimization reports. Recommendations only — never edits agents.

nodes.label: bicep-validate-subagent
nodes.description: Bicep validation subagent. Runs lint (bicep lint + build) first, then code review (AVM standards, naming, security baseline, governance). Returns PASS/FAIL + APPROVED/NEEDS_REVISION/FAILED verdict.

nodes.label: bicep-whatif-subagent
nodes.description: Bicep deployment preview subagent. Runs az deployment group what-if to preview changes. Analyzes policy violations, resource changes, cost impact. Returns structured summary.

nodes.label: challenger-review-subagent
nodes.description: Unified adversarial review subagent that challenges Azure infrastructure artifacts. Finds untested assumptions, governance gaps, WAF blind spots, and architectural weaknesses. Returns structured JSON findings. Supports single-pass and multi-pass rotating-lens reviews; batches lenses per invocation.

nodes.label: cost-estimate-subagent
nodes.description: Azure cost estimation subagent. Uses Azure Resource Manager MCP retail pricing and cost data, then returns a structured cost breakdown through a file-based contract.

nodes.label: policy-precheck-subagent
nodes.description: Live Azure Policy precheck subagent (L3). Cross-checks live policy state vs governance constraints, runs what-if/plan validation, returns deterministic deploy_gate (PROCEED|BLOCK) + status (CLEAN|INFORMATIONAL|BLOCKED|FAILED) for Deploy agents (07b/07t).

nodes.label: terraform-plan-subagent
nodes.description: Terraform deployment preview subagent. Runs terraform plan to preview changes before deployment. Classifies resources into create/update/destroy/replace, highlights destructive ops, returns structured change summary.

nodes.label: terraform-validate-subagent
nodes.description: Terraform validation subagent. Runs lint (fmt -check, validate) first, then code review (AVM-TF standards, naming, security baseline, RBAC, governance). Returns PASS/FAIL + APPROVED/NEEDS_REVISION/FAILED verdict.
